items.title: BCB confirms new six-team franchise competition
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) is set to launch a new six-team, franchise-based domestic competition spanning three formats.

items.title: ‘Difference between India and us is quite big’: Joty admits after 114-run defeat
items.summary: Bangladesh women’s side suffered another heavy 114-run defeat, this time against India in the Asian Games semifinal in Nisshin, Japan, on Sunday, with skipper Nigar Sultana Joty stating that the gap between India and Bangladesh is quite big.

items.title: Shafali storm crushes Bangladesh, India march into final
items.summary: The defeat leaves Bangladesh with one final chance to return from the Games with a medal.

items.title: Why Amite omitted after just one Test
items.summary: Amite’s exclusion came after the 25-year-old had limited opportunities to prove himself at Test level. On the back of a run-spree in the domestic circuit, he made his debut against Zimbabwe in June, scoring 29, and later made 15 and four against Cricket Australia XI in a three-day practice match in Australia, where most of Bangladesh’s batters struggled as the Tigers suffered a heavy defeat.

items.title: Bangladesh pick Hridoy for one-off Test against Afghanistan
items.summary: Nahid Rana and Taskin Ahmed were not available due to fitness and workload management issues

items.title: Hridoy, Jaker return for Afghanistan Test, Taskin rested
items.summary: Bangladesh will play the one-off Test against Afghanistan on October 9 in the UAE.

items.title: Dot balls the big concern as Bangladesh look to test favourites India
items.summary: India are the pre-eminent team in Asia and go into the Asian Games semi-finals just a week after winning the Asia Cup for a record eighth time

items.title: Bangladesh turn up, China don't as friendly cancelled
items.summary: According to team manager S M Golam Faiyaz, Bangladesh arrived at the ground in the morning and waited for China before eventually using the time for a training session ahead of Sunday's semifinal against India.

items.title: Charani, Shafali power India past Japan and into Asian Games semi-finals
items.summary: India set up semi-finals date with Bangladesh on September 20 for a spot in the gold-medal match

items.title: Bangladesh through to semi-final after washout against China
items.summary: Bangladesh will now take on the winner of India vs Japan in the semi-final

items.title: Bangladesh to tour Nepal for three T20Is in March 2027
items.summary: It will be the first international bilateral series between the two countries
